description: Repairs r-fmt-1/create-accdb-collating-general: every creation passed the same LANGID 0x0409, so reading CollatingOrder back could only show 1033 and gave no contrast. Asks, for three new ACCDB databases made by CreateDatabase(path, locale, 128) with dbLangGeneral (LANGID 0x0409), ;LANGID=0x0407;CP=1252;COUNTRY=0 and ;LANGID=0x0809;CP=1252;COUNTRY=0: Database.CollatingOrder at creation; T(ID Long primary key, S TEXT(20)) with index IX_S; the refreshed field list of T (S's CollatingOrder); and, after close and a read-only reopen, CollatingOrder and the field list again.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
